block.rs_create_compat.unit_pattern_mana.en: Manages the unit patterns of every execution chamber in the network, grouped by chamber; all sequence assembly vaults are merged into one in-memory view. Distinct from the autocrafter manager (which manages autocrafting patterns).
block.rs_create_compat.unit_pattern_mana.zh: 管理网络中每台执行舱的单元样板（按执行舱分组），并把全部序列装配样板库的样板内存合并为一个视图。与「自动合成管理舱」（管自动合成样板）区分。

gui.rs_create_compat.unit_pattern_manage.zh: 序列装配样板库（网络合并）

gui.rs_create_compat.unit_pattern_manage.en: No execution chamber in this network
